What we do

Six trades, one call away

Every job is quoted upfront and carried out by a technician who specialises in that trade — not a generalist guessing at it.

Toilet Servicing

A full bathroom refresh, not just a clean.

  • Anti-mould sealant & ceiling paint
  • Tile grout & leak repair
  • Choke clearing & scent diffuser

Glass & Mirror

Replacements measured and fitted with precision.

  • Window & sliding door glass
  • Shower screen replacement
  • Cabinet & wall mirror installation

Wooden Door Repairs

Sticking, sagging or squeaking — sorted.

  • Lock replacement
  • Hinge replacement
  • Full door alignment

Furniture & Handyman

Assembly and installs for everyday home needs.

  • Furniture assembly & drilling
  • Light fixture installation
  • Taobao / Lazada / Shopee assembly

Silicone & Caulk

Old, mouldy silicone stripped and resealed clean.

  • Bathroom & kitchen resealing
  • Sink & wash basin silicone
  • Windows & sliding door silicone

Sliding Door Repair

Smooth-running doors, front and back.

  • Roller replacement
  • Lock & glass replacement
  • Residential & commercial rates

Getting started

Three steps to a fixed home

01

Call or WhatsApp us

Tell us what's broken and send a photo if you have one — it helps us bring the right parts.

02

Get a fixed quote

We confirm the price and a time slot that works for you before anyone steps foot in your home.

03

We fix it, once

Our technician completes the job, tidies up after themselves, and walks you through what was done.
